description.value: Sahota's Live Grill is a well-established Indian and Western fusion restaurant that has been operating for over a decade across Surrey, Langley, and Abbotsford. It is best known for its live grill concept, where chefs cook meats and seafood over an open flame in view of diners, turning the meal into a culinary experience. With a capacity of 140, outdoor seating, a full bar, and takeout and delivery options, it serves a broad range of needs for cyclists passing through the 56 Avenue corridor.
